prompt:
The section file sections/store-map-defaults.liquid renders a store map and a list of location blocks. Its markup is correct and must stay exactly as it is. Only the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block may change. The current schema has missing defaults and defaults with the wrong type, so a freshly added section renders with an empty heading, a broken iframe and invalid range values. Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following, with keys and array items in the order listed: Top level: "name": "Store map", "tag": "section", "class": "map-section-wrapper", "max_blocks": 4, then "settings", "blocks" and "presets". settings (section.settings), in this order: 1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Visit our store". 2. type "text", id "address", label "Address", default "80 Spadina Ave, Toronto". 3. type "range", id "zoom", label "Zoom level", min 1, max 20, step 1, default 14. All four values must be JSON numbers, not strings. 4. type "select", id "height", label "Map height". options in this order: value "small" with label "Small", value "medium" with label "Medium", value "large" with label "Large". default "medium". The default must exactly match an option value, including lowercase. 5. type "range", id "padding", label "Vertical padding", min 0, max 96, step 4, unit "px", default 36. All numbers must be JSON numbers. The default must lie on the step grid. 6. type "color", id "background_color", label "Background color", default "#f4f4f4". 7. type "checkbox", id "show_border", label "Show border", default true. The default must be the JSON boolean true, not a string. blocks: exactly one block type, with keys type "location", name "Location", and settings in this order: - type "text", id "name", label "Location name", default "Downtown". - type "richtext", id "hours", label "Opening hours", default "

Mon-Fri 9am-6pm

". Richtext defaults must be wrapped in a

element. presets: exactly one preset, with name "Store map" and blocks [{"type": "location"}]. Do not add any other keys, for example no info, placeholder or extra settings. Change only sections/store-map-defaults.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
